journey.name: wear restore word entry
journey.description:
The word screen of the restore: the word count choice, the progress, the suggestion chips after two letters, the rotary crown scrolling to the chips below the screen edge, and a chip tap that accepts the word and moves on. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, turn the crown or the bezel instead of `rotaryencoder`).
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: none, the journey stops before the wallet is saved. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Verify the title (tag "RestoreTitle") reads "How many words?"
Type `ab` into "RestoreWordInput" without pressing Enter (README › Typing, steps 2 and 3)
Verify the chip "RestoreSuggestion-0" is listed with the text "abandon" at its `center`
Verify the sixth chip "RestoreSuggestion-5" is not listed: it is below the screen edge
Turn the crown down: `adb shell input rotaryencoder scroll --axis SCROLL,-3` (README › Watch gestures)
Verify "RestoreSuggestion-5" is now listed with the text "absent" at its `center`: the crown scrolled the screen
Turn the crown back up: `adb shell input rotaryencoder scroll --axis SCROLL,3`
